item.text:
## Summary

Fix timeout results incorrectly reported as success by two backends when they returned exit status zero alongside a timeout error in the response. The adapter now checks that response field before mapping the result; all other result semantics remain unchanged.

This change introduces a reusable, runtime-neutral validation adapter that normalizes success and failure results across three existing backends. It consolidates shared status mapping, error attribution, timeout classification, and backend capability reporting.

## Validation

- Regression cases for both affected backends pass.
- The full test suite passes.

## Scope

No new backend, dependency, or migration is included.

---

I opened with the incorrect timeout behavior and its fix so the next reviewer sees the functional impact before the adapter consolidation.
